## Summary
Implements **P08.1 — the reconciliation resolver** (`docs/tickets/P08.1__resolver.md`, canonical spec §28), the intellectual core of the project: a deterministic, rule-based `RESOLVE(subject, predicate, as_of_world, as_of_belief, ruleset)` running the fixed Phase 0–7 pipeline over one subject/predicate pair.

Purely additive — 7 new files, **no existing file modified** (back-compat, SIG-RECON-021 / additive invariant).

## What changed
- `reconcile/src/reconcile/data/ruleset.toml` + `ruleset.py` — the ruleset **as data** (versioned, diffable, testable, separately attributable): numeric tolerances, the strategy vocabulary, the versioned rationale templates, and the style-guide word-lists. Per-predicate epistemics stay in the ontology-owned predicate registry the resolver consumes.
- `reconcile/src/reconcile/resolve.py` — `Claim`, `Resolution`, and `RESOLVE()`: gather → admissibility → canonicalize (incl. Phase 2.2 value-domain and 2.3 count-basis conflation guards) → weight → independence → strategy → ambiguity → emit; the universal total-order tie-break; the `U0–U8` ambiguity test; per-class/per-method independence; `input_digest`; and `pin()` for human override.
- `reconcile/src/reconcile/rationale.py` — versioned-template rationale generation and the committed `check_template` (clauses a–e).
- Tests: `tests/reconcile/test_resolve.py`, `test_rationale.py`, `test_ruleset.py`.

## Design decisions
- **No random tie-break anywhere** (SIG-RECON-007): the order is `(weight desc, method_breadth desc, observed_at desc, source_registry_rank asc, claim_id asc)`; `claim_id` makes it total. Recency is neutralized for IMMUTABLE/GLACIAL predicates (SIG-RECON-010), in both candidate ranking and representative selection.
- **`U5` is load-bearing** (SIG-RECON-015): a stale winner on a MODERATE/FAST/VOLATILE predicate returns `UNRESOLVED` with `last_known` + date **even with no dissent**. Because a HISTORICAL (`C4`) claim floors to `W1`, a U5 winner needs a strong direct source (e.g. an R1 open-data release at `C3`), else `U1` correctly fires first.
- **Ruleset split**: the composed weight table (§10.6) and query-time currency (§28.3) stay in `reconcile.weight` (pinned to Appendix D.2); the *policy* (tolerances, templates, strategy vocab, version) is the ruleset file; per-predicate strategy/volatility/directness stay in the ontology registry. `resolver_version` and `ruleset_version` are independent (SIG-STORE-017).
- **Determinism vs. wall-clock**: `computed_at` is excluded from `decision_key()` and `input_digest`, so identical inputs are byte-reproducible while the record still carries its compute time.
- **`interval_union`/`interval_intersection`**: the registry currently assigns these only to scalar predicates (integer/boolean) — there is no interval-typed predicate to merge — so they resolve via the deterministic total order.

SIG-RECON-004/005/006/007/008/010/011/012/013/014/015/016/017/018/020/021/022/023/024/025; SIG-EPIS-014/017/018/019/020/023/025/026/027/028; SIG-STORE-014; §25.2 (LLMs never resolve or produce confidence).

## Out of scope (guarded)
Per-predicate workflows (P08.2, `counts.py` untouched); the materialized `Contradiction` entity + byte-identical L3 rebuild (P08.3 — this ticket only *emits* contradictions and `input_digest`); L4 inference (P12). Automatic research-task generation on `UNRESOLVED` (§33) is left to the tasks phase; `UNRESOLVED` is already a first-class, non-hidden outcome that surfaces all candidates + `last_known`.

## Acceptance criteria → evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Deterministic; no random tie-break; total order proven over identical inputs | `test_resolution_is_deterministic_over_identical_inputs` (all permutations → identical `decision_key`/`input_digest`), `test_total_order_breaks_ties_by_registry_rank_then_claim_id` |
| Tier-A contract does **not** win `active_device_count` vs a `D1` portal snapshot | `test_contract_never_wins_active_device_count`, `test_appendix_d2_active_count_portal_beats_contract` |
| `D6` claims **excluded**, not down-weighted | `test_d6_portal_snapshot_contributes_nothing_to_contract_signed_date`, `test_d6_excluded_does_not_beat_a_real_signing_claim` |
| `U5` fires on a stale unchallenged FAST value → `UNRESOLVED` + `last_known` + date | `test_u5_fires_on_stale_unchallenged_value`, `test_u5_does_not_fire_on_immutable_predicate` |
| Three sources copying one upstream = one independence class | `test_three_sources_copying_one_upstream_count_as_one_class` |
| Rationales quotable; never a support + agreement term in one sentence | `test_every_committed_template_passes_all_five_clauses` + negative controls; `test_live_resolution_rationale_is_quotable_and_conformant` |
| Human override records author + rationale, both results shown | `test_override_records_author_and_rationale_and_keeps_algo_result`, `test_override_requires_author_and_rationale` |
| Phase gate | reconcile suite (57) green; repo-wide `pytest` (1296) green; `mypy` (123 files) clean; `ruff` lint+format clean; `verify-gen` no drift |
